question: Two pipes, P and Q, can fill a cistern in 37 minutes 30 seconds and 45 minutes, respectively. Both pipes are opened simultaneously. The cistern gets completely filled in exactly 30 minutes if pipe Q is turned off after x minutes. Find x.7002
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take total work = 225

P efficiency = 6, Q efficiency = 5

P works full 30 min ⇒ work = 6 × 30 = 180

Remaining work = 45

Time by Q = 45 ÷ 5 = 9

**∴ Answer = 9 minutes**
